decision: Admit the concrete source, correctness and semantic output evidence for the fixed performance study, with strict per-arm output guards and explicit cross-arm metadata limits.
reason: Compiler-specific shared-context namespaces change dependency metadata hashes. Requiring raw rmeta equality across those independently compiled dependency graphs is stronger than the intended correctness test. Focused source tests and actual generated-code/debug-info comparisons are concrete correctness evidence. Serialized metadata equivalence is not claimed.
supersedes: Only the original correctness-preflight requirement to resolve every cross-arm serialized metadata byte difference before measurement. All input, source, runtime, restoration, diagnostics and statistical requirements remain.
evidence: All seven focused compiler correctness tests pass, including attribute hit/invalidation/hygiene/diagnostics and existing derive-cache guards.
Actual uv tracing attribute query expn131 for skip_all on run loads from disk with no provider invocation.
All207 ordered native library archive object payloads are identical across arms.
Executable code, data, relocation and symbol payloads are exact. Complete decoded DWARF matches after only the two bound namespace path components; source/line/span/checksum records are preserved.
All four retained rmeta listings succeed with empty stderr. All listed items, fields and target modifiers match except117 dependency hashes and uv private/public hashes.
Per-arm rmeta hashes remain exactly stable between controlled AFTER and restored-original builds.
The new uvx-test alternate has exactly33 differing bytes: .rodata section-header sh_entsize8 versus0 and the32-byte GNU build-ID descriptor. All other bytes and program headers are exact.
measurement_output_guards: Bind exact per-arm rmeta hashes; unexpected within-arm changes fail the attempt.
Bind exact per-arm executable hashes. For uvx-test only, accept the two newly authenticated concrete hashes; do not carry over any prior fixture allowance.
For rlib, preserve all207 ordered native object payloads and archive structure; allow only the actual source-defined per-invocation CGU filename substitutions reviewed in the accounting.
No broad ELF, DWARF or metadata masks; retain raw outputs and exact exception manifests.
Bind the fresh fixture registry-directory absence as None and require it remain absent, rather than assuming a directory must exist.

metadata_limit.test_build: A one-byte length difference and remaining differences including shifted encodings remain unclassified.
metadata_limit.instruction: Retain and report this limit. Do not describe all metadata bytes as equivalent or fully explained.

unchanged: Four discovery pairs and all confirmation/native sample orders, counts, estimators, seeds, confidence thresholds, failure/retry policies and regression blockers are unchanged. No A/B effect has been observed or produced.
remaining: Concrete final harness/input freeze and stage-specific run authority.
